note: check=deterministic rules run in code (craft standards check, no model) on NEW code only; check=llm rules are judged by the quality-gate agent. Keep deterministic rules conservative: a false FAIL costs a resend.

rules.text: a source file must not cross 1500 lines; split into the right layer
no abbreviations in type names (Repository, not Repo; Service, not Svc; Manager, not Mgr)
use the injected logger with structured fields, not console
classes, methods, parameters and private fields have descriptive names that say what they do and on what; no bare verbs, no abbreviations
a class or method does one thing; a service over about 150 lines or mixing fetch, map and save is split (fetch, build, save)
business rules live in the domain/service layer, not in controllers or repositories; layers depend in one direction
reuse an existing method, class or helper listed in the Reuse map before creating a new one
logs are structured (message template plus fields), at the right level, with no secrets or personal data
